```yaml
name: Smoke tests – Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  smoke-mastodon:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: smoke-mastodon-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Set up Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v1
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build test harness
        run: npm run build:harness

      - name: Start Mastodon stack and harness
        run: |
          docker compose -f docker-compose.smoke-mastodon.yml up --build -d
        env:
          # expose any required env vars for the compose file
          MASTODON_DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          REDIS_PASSWORD: redis

      - name: Wait for services to be healthy
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for Mastodon and harness to be ready..."
          for i in {1..30}; do
            mastodon_ready=$(curl -s -f http://localhost:4001/api/v1/instance || echo "no")
            harness_ready=$(curl -s -f http://localhost:4000/_test/health || echo "no")
            if [[ "$mastodon_ready" == *"instance"* && "$harness_ready" == *"ok"* ]]; then
              echo "Both services are ready."
              break
            fi
            echo "Services not ready yet (attempt $i)..."
            sleep 5
          done
          if [[ "$mastodon_ready" != *"instance"* || "$harness_ready" != *"ok"* ]]; then
            echo "Services failed to start in time."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run orchestrator
        run: |
          deno run --allow-net --allow-env test/smoke/orchestrator.ts
        env:
          # Provide any required environment variables for the orchestrator
          MASTODON_URL: http://localhost:4001
          FEDIFY_URL: http://localhost:4000
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Stop services
        if: always()
        run: docker compose -f docker-compose.smoke-mastodon.yml down

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: 'Smoke tests – Mastodon'
          path: 'test-results/**/*.xml'
          reporter: jest-junit
          list-suites: true
          list-tests: true
          only-summary: true

      - name: Show test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          paths: 'test-results/**/*.xml'
          output: 'test-summary.md'
          show: true
          folded: false
```
